text: About Electronics Components Manufacturing Scheme (ECMS): Background: Approved in April 2025 by the Government of India (Gol) with an outlay of Rs. 22,919 crore for Financial Year (FY) 2025-26 to FY32 (with a one-year gestation), later proposed to be enhanced to Rs. 40,000 crore. Objective: Develop a robust electronics component ecosystem by boosting Domestic Value Addition (DVA) and integrating with Global Value Chains (GVCs). Incentives: Provide support through turnover-linked, Capital Expenditure (Capex)-linked, and hybrid incentive structures. Target: Achieve a USD 500 billion domestic electronics manufacturing ecosystem by 2030-31.
